metadata.description:
The Stone Arch Bridge is a rare gem—an old railway crossing turned pedestrian paradise. Built in 1883 with native granite and limestone, it curves gracefully over Saint Anthony Falls and offers unmatched skyline views. Walking its length feels like stepping through layers of Minneapolis history. You’ve earned this Bridge Builder POAP for visiting the crown jewel of crossings in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Bridge Builder 
GPS: 44.98074, -93.25369 
Map: https://www.google.com/maps/place/44.98074,-93.25369 
Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stone_Arch_Bridge_(Minneapolis)
